## Checks

- [ ] Every commit is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) (`fix(cli): …`), and so is the title if this is one self-contained change
- [ ] `docs/changelog.md`: a line under *Unreleased*, ending with this pull request's link (or the `no-changelog` label, for a change no user can notice)
- [ ] The documentation page a user reads about this change
- [ ] `docs/cli.md`, for a change to the command line
- [ ] Tests, covering at least 80 % of the changed lines
- [ ] Runtime dependencies changed: named here, so that the bioconda recipe follows at the release
